# Warden — AI workforce OS

> Every human gets a copilot. Every team gets an agent hierarchy.
> One human asks their copilot; copilots find the right owner and resolve it —
> the other human is never interrupted.

## Product

- **Onboarding**: describe your company, pick capacities (Tech, SEO/AEO, Social),
  connect code via GitHub repo or local runner, import context from Warden
  bundles or ChatGPT/Claude chat exports.
- **Demo workspace**: sandboxed company with agents plus copilots for humans.
  A live alert replays a copilot-to-copilot handoff end to end.
- **Dashboard**: Home priority window, agent studio, reports, backlogs.
- **Code edits**: agents branch and open PRs directly on git (GitHub path),
  or execute on private folders through the local runner client.

## Key pages

- `/` — landing, signup, and demo workspace entry
- App tabs: Home (priority + copilot handoff alert), Agents, Reports, Backlogs
